messages:
deploy-bot: [canary-start] service=runtime env=prod-us-west tag=release-2026-03-20-canary commit=abcd1234 fraction=5% started by @julie. release_notes=https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20 (logs and timeline attached)
julie: kicking off smoke and synthetic checks. watching traces and cost dashboard.
mike: noted, I'll watch embeddings and reranker routes. ping me on any 5xx spikes.
infra-bot: smoke-checks: 
- /health runtime: 200 OK
- /embed health: 200 OK
- synthetic chat flow: 48/50 ok, 2 failures (504 on reranker)
logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-20T11:05:12Z reranker: request_id=xyz123 status=504 upstream_timeout
2026-03-20T11:05:13Z embed: host=gpu-3 OOM on allocate
```
mike: seeing 2x 500s on /v1/embeddings around 11:05 UTC. tagging @sarah for infra logs.
sarah: looking now. gpu-3 shows memory pressure spikes after latest runtime kernel bump. suspect quant kernel mismatch with certain model configs.
julie: pause promotion and set canary fraction=0% while we triage. don't promote until signoff. :eyes:
deploy-bot: [canary-update] fraction=0% paused_by=@julie
infra-bot: metric-snapshot: p95 latency +25% vs baseline, error_rate=3.2% (embeddings). dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/rt123/canary-metrics
mike: reproduced locally with quantized kernels + model v2.4. creating hotfix branch to revert kernel change. will build new image tag.
julie: prefer hotfix image over pinning old model if quick. plan: build hotfix, deploy small canary 2% -> 10% -> 25% on green.
mike: hotfix branch created: abcd-hotfix. building image tag=release-2026-03-20-hotfix-1 commit=beef5678. starting canary 2% 
deploy-bot: [canary-start] service=runtime env=prod-us-west tag=release-2026-03-20-hotfix-1 commit=beef5678 fraction=2% initiated by @mike
infra-bot: quick-smoke: all checks passed. synthetic chat flow 50/50 ok. no reranker 504s observed. traces show steady p95.
julie: good. ramp to 10% in 5m if no regressions. monitor p95 threshold 1.5s and error_rate threshold 1%.
mike: ack. alerts set.
deploy-bot: [canary-update] fraction=10% (auto-ramp)
infra-bot: 10m check: p95 within threshold, error_rate=0.2%. CPU/GPU stable.
sarah: logs look clean on gpu-3. memory leak not observed with hotfix.
julie: schedule promotion to 25% then 50% over 30m if stable.
mike: will watch. tell me if any alert fires.
deploy-bot: [canary-promotion] fraction=25% scheduled by @julie (gradual ramping policy=linear 25% over 10m)
sarah: monitoring; all good so far :thumbsup:
infra-bot: 25m snapshot: p95 +2% vs baseline, error_rate 0.15%, token_throughput nominal. no new 5xx.
julie: unless objections, promote to 100% after final 10m check.
mike: no objections.
deploy-bot: [canary-finish] promoted. final_fraction=100% final_tag=release-2026-03-20-hotfix-1 duration=~40m pinned_rollback_target=release-2026-03-19-v1.4.2
julie: release notes updated with hotfix summary and root cause: quantized kernel regression with model config. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20/notes-hotfix
mike: follow-up: adding an e2e test for quantized kernel compatibility in CI and a post-deploy canary smoke that hits embeddings route specifically.
sarah: I'll open a small infra ticket to add node-level OOM alerts for GPUs and pin kernel rollouts behind feature flag.
julie: thanks everyone. adding brief incident note to release (no customer-facing incident). :shipit:
deploy-bot: thread closed by @julie (reason: promoted to 100%, hotfix applied).
